name: Graduate
description: A polygon gaining a side every few columns — triangle at one edge, near-circle at the other.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: @calc(3 + 9 * @x / @X); scale: 0.94); clip-path: @shape(points: @calc(3 + 9 * @x / @X); scale: 0.94); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
